t: Video: Superfest—a look at East Germany’s extremely durable drinking glass
s: Before anything could be done to potentially decrease Superfest’s extreme durability, the brand’s parent company, VEB Sachsenglas Schwepnitz, went bankrupt after the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989. Since then, Superfest glasses were exiled to live on in vintage shops, personal collections, and Ebay listings—which may sound familiar to those who know the story of Depression glass.
